messages:
Priya S: Heads-up 10am sync with MeridianCare tomorrow. They're asking for a 10-day POC. Requirements: IdP-initiated SSO (SAML), automatic SCIM provisioning with delta/partial updates, AD-group-to-role sync, and the ability to lock model access per verified domain. Also want IP allowlist for SCIM callbacks and explicit KMS details for keys. Can we confirm what we can promise in the pre-POC doc? cc @Ethan L @Nora K

Ethan L: We do IdP-initiated SAML + SP-initiated. We validate signatures, audience, recipient, and enforce authnContext if they request. We'll provide our SAML metadata endpoint for automated setup.

Nora K: SCIM 2.0 supported. We have /Users GET/POST/PATCH and support bulk provisioning. Delta syncs are supported via PATCH with ETag and lastModified filtering. We recommend incremental syncs (since full re-provisioning is heavy). For high-rate syncs (>50k deltas/day) we need to scope it as a performance add-on.

Priya S: Good. They want AD group mapping to our RBAC roles and want to preserve external group GUIDs. Any caveats?

Ethan L: We map external group IDs -> role bindings. Caveat: if the IdP rotates group GUIDs (rare) you can see a short mismatch; our reconciler runs every 3 minutes and applies idempotent binds. We'll document that and add a retry/backoff for their side.

Nora K: For multiple domains: we require domain ownership proof. Preferred is DNS TXT at the domain apex. If they only control subdomains, we accept TXT at the subdomain or a CNAME delegation trick. We'll note this in the onboarding checklist.

Priya S: LegalBot raised a questionnaire item: "Do you offer customer-managed KMS for service account keys?" Also: "How long are audit logs retained and can we extend?"

LegalBot: For Hosted: we support customer-managed keys via partner KMS integrations (bring your own key). For Dedicated/Private: BYOK/HSM supported per contract. Audit logs default retention 90 days; enterprise plans can get 12 months or custom retention via archiving to their storage.

Priya S: They asked if SCIM callbacks can come from fixed IPs for allowlisting. Realistic?

InfraBot: For Dedicated: yes, static egress IPs and VPC-only endpoints available. For Hosted: we publish a stable set of outbound CIDRs, but we cannot guarantee single IP per callback. Alternative: set up VPC peering or an inbound webhook via their firewall (we can support a customer-hosted connector in their VPC).

Ethan L: SLA note: Hosted enterprise tier offers 99.9% for auth flows (SAML/SCIM) with incident response SLA. Dedicated gets a higher uptime SLA depending on reservation. We'll include the exact wording in the contract addendum.

Priya S: Pricing question from MeridianCare: is SCIM metered on hosted? Or covered by Dedicated reservation?

Nora K: Hosted: SCIM control-plane calls counted under admin API request units (small per-request charge). Dedicated: normal control-plane included; extreme scale syncs may be add-on. We'll ask them for expected active user count + daily delta volume.

Priya S: Ops blockers to surface before POC start: 1) They need subdomain proofing process documented. 2) Need static IPs or alternative for SCIM callbacks. 3) Legal wants KMS + retention writeup. 4) Confirm whether mutual TLS for SCIM is possible during POC.

Ethan L: mTLS for SCIM is possible but needs engineering sign-off; we can offer it as short-lived config for the POC if they can accept a minor engineering workorder (timeline 3-5 business days).

Priya S: Action items: Ethan - SAML metadata + failure modes doc. Nora - SCIM delta thresholds, sample requests, and reconciliation description. LegalBot - formal KMS + retention language for questionnaire. InfraBot - outbound CIDRs and Dedicated egress options. I'll compile into a pre-POC checklist and share with MeridianCare.

InfraBot: Note: created ticket POC-7864 (owner: Priya S) and attached a sample CIDR list.

Priya S: Thanks team. I'll send the checklist and ask for expected user counts before the sync. :pray:
